fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the substation as presented in the LTDS dataset. This field provides a clear and recognisable identifier for users when interpreting the data. It is used consistently across the dataset to support navigation, filtering, and cross-referencing with other LTDS outputs.
fields.label: name

fields.name: mrid
fields.description: Unique and persistent identifier for each record. For this publication, mRIDs are generated specifically for the published Capacity Heatmap dataset and are not aligned to LTDS CIM grid model identifiers.
fields.label: mRID

fields.name: description
fields.description: Additional information
fields.label: description

fields.name: type
fields.description: This field indicates the type of substation, with all entries in this dataset representing primary substations.
fields.label: type

fields.name: area
fields.description: The name of the licence area, provided using the abbreviations: EPN (Eastern Power Networks), LPN (London Power Networks), and SPN (South Eastern Power Networks).
fields.label: area

fields.name: bsp
fields.description: Identifies the BSP (Bulk Supply Point) from which the substation is supplied.
fields.label: BSP

fields.name: gsp
fields.description: Identifies the Grid Supply Point (GSP) to which the substation is connected.
fields.label: GSP

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: The latitude value of the substation as a single latitude point.
fields.label: latitude

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: The longitude value of the substation as a single longitude point.
fields.label: longitude

fields.name: voltages
fields.description: The voltage levels at the Substation.
fields.label: Voltages

fields.name: demandavailablecapacity
fields.description: Demand available capacity is derived from the Network Scenario Headroom Report, which provides the demand headroom at primary and grid substations. This assessment is based on the latest Distribution Future Energy Scenarios (DFES) 2025, baseline utilisation and network ratings from the LTDS November 2025, and includes consideration of planned network developments and operational flexibility. For further details, users should refer to the Network Scenario Headroom Reports.
fields.label: demandAvailableCapacity

fields.name: demandconstraint
fields.description: Demand constraint is determined based on the utilisation factor of the substation, calculated as the ratio of maximum demand to firm capacity. The resulting headroom is expressed using a Red–Amber–Green (RAG) classification: values greater than or equal to +5% are classified as Green, values less than or equal to −5% are classified as Red, and values between −5% and +5% are classified as Amber.
fields.label: demandConstraint

fields.name: demandconstraintlimitingfactor
fields.description: The demand constraint limiting factor is identified by grouping the underlying limitation types into categories as voltage constraints or thermal constraints.
fields.label: demandConstraintLimitingFactor

fields.name: demandfirmcapacity
fields.description: The firm capacity for demand at the substation. This value is consistent with the capacity reported in LTDS Table 3A and Table 3B.
fields.label: demandFirmCapacity

fields.name: demandmaximum
fields.description: Maximum demand represents the peak load observed at primary substations currently supplying demand. The dataset includes only substations owned and operated by UK Power Networks and excludes customer-owned substations, substations dedicated to a single customer, and planned substations that are not yet in service. The values are sourced from LTDS Table 3A, with the most onerous value between summer and winter peak demand conditions reported
fields.label: demandMaximum

fields.name: demandminimum
fields.description: Minimum demand at the substation is derived using the minimum load scaling factor in LTDS Table 3A. Negative values arise due to reverse power flow at the substation.
fields.label: demandMinimum

fields.name: generationavailablecapacity
fields.description: Available generation capacity at the substation. This value is derived from the Network Scenario Headroom Report. For further details, users should refer to the Network Scenario Headroom Reports.
fields.label: generationAvailableCapacity

fields.name: generationbudgetestimatesprovidedcapacity
fields.description: Total capacity for generation connections at the substation for which budget has been estimated.
fields.label: generationBudgetEstimatesProvidedCapacity

fields.name: generationbudgetestimatesprovidedcount
fields.description: Total number of budget estimates provided for generation connections at the substation.
fields.label: generationBudgetEstimatesProvidedCount

fields.name: generationconnectionoffersacceptedcapacity
fields.description: Total capacity offered and accepted for generation connections at the substation.
fields.label: generationConnectionOffersAcceptedCapacity

fields.name: generationconnectionoffersacceptedcount
fields.description: Total number of connection offers accepted for generation connections at the substation.
fields.label: generationConnectionOffersAcceptedCount

fields.name: generationconnectionoffersmadecapacity
fields.description: Total capacity offered and not yet accepted by customers for generation connections at the substation
fields.label: generationConnectionOffersMadeCapacity

fields.name: generationconnectionoffersmadecount
fields.description: Total number of connection offers made and not yet accepted by customers for generation connections at the substation.
fields.label: generationConnectionOffersMadeCount

fields.name: generationconstraint
fields.description: Generation constraint is determined based on the utilisation of the generation firm capacity at the substation. The remaining capacity is expressed using a Red–Amber–Green (RAG) classification: values greater than or equal to +5% are classified as Green, values less than or equal to −5% are classified as Red, and values between −5% and +5% are classified as Amber. This approach is consistent with the methodology applied for demand constraints.
fields.label: generationConstraint

fields.name: generationconstraintlimitingfactor
fields.description: The generation constraint limiting factor is identified by grouping the underlying limitation types into categories as voltage constraints or thermal constraints.
fields.label: generationConstraintLimitingFactor

fields.name: generationfirmcapacity
fields.description: The total firm generation capacity of the substation. This is calculated based on the available generation capacity and the existing generation capacity at substation level.
fields.label: generationFirmCapacity

fields.name: loadbudgetestimatesprovidedcapacity
fields.description: Total capacity for demand connections at the substation for which budget has been estimated.
fields.label: loadBudgetEstimatesProvidedCapacity

fields.name: loadbudgetestimatesprovidedcount
fields.description: Total number of budget estimates provided for demand connections at the substation.
fields.label: loadBudgetEstimatesProvidedCount

fields.name: loadconnectionoffersacceptedcapacity
fields.description: Total capacity offered and not yet accepted by customers for demand connections at the substation.
fields.label: loadConnectionOffersAcceptedCapacity

fields.name: loadconnectionoffersacceptedcount
fields.description: Total number of connection offers accepted for demand connections at the substation
fields.label: loadConnectionOffersAcceptedCount

fields.name: loadconnectionoffersmadecapacity
fields.description: Total capacity offered and not yet accepted by customers for demand connections at the substation.
fields.label: loadConnectionOffersMadeCapacity

fields.name: loadconnectionoffersmadecount
fields.description: Total number of connection offers made and not yet accepted by customers for demand connections at the substation
fields.label: loadConnectionOffersMadeCount

fields.name: voltage
fields.description: Proposed connection voltage.
fields.label: voltage

fields.name: reversepowerflowavailablecapacity
fields.description: Reverse power flow available capacity represents the additional headroom available when minimum demand is negative, indicating reverse power flow at the substation.
fields.label: reversePowerFlowAvailableCapacity

fields.name: reversepowerflowtotalcapacity
fields.description: Reverse power flow total capacity is calculated based on the available reverse power capability of the transformers connected to the relevant substations. The reverse power capability values are sourced from LTDS Table 2A for two-winding transformers and Table 2B for three-winding transformers. The calculation considers an N-1 scenario, and where reverse power capability is indicated as “<100”, a value of 50% is assumed
fields.label: reversePowerFlowTotalCapacity

fields.description: geo-point
fields.label: geometry_wkt_epsg4326

default.title: Long Term Development Statement (LTDS) Capacity Heatmap
default.description:
Introduction

The Capacity Heatmap data is a requirement defined in Form of Long Term Development Statement (LTDS) and is being published for the first time as part of this LTDS cycle. As described in Section 6 of the Form of LTDS, the data provides a standardised view of available network capacity, constraints, and recent connection activity across the distribution network. It supports users in understanding where demand and generation connections may be possible, where network constraints may exist, and how recent connection activity may influence future network planning and connection decisions. Further details on the Capacity Heatmap data structure and requirements are provided in LTDS Capacity Heatmaps Appendix 1 – Information Model. The latest version of the appendix is available through BSI GB CIM Engagement Hub.

The heatmap data is structured around a HeatmapDataSet, which represents a single published dataset and contains publication metadata such as the dataset title, description, publisher, issue date, validity period, coverage, format, and rights information. Within the HeatmapDataSet, Substation records provide the main operational view of the network, including location, voltage levels, licence area, demand and generation capacities, available capacity, constraint indicators, limiting factors, and references to related network hierarchy points such as Grid Supply Points (GSPs) and Bulk Supply Points (BSPs).

The dataset also includes ConnectionActivity for substations where connection activity has occurred during the past year. This element summarises the number and total capacity of budget estimates provided, connection offers made, and connection offers accepted for both demand and generation connections. It provides useful context for interpreting available capacity, as it shows recent customer activity that may affect future network utilisation and planning decisions. 

For more information please see the UK Power Networks guide to Capacity Heatmaps: UK Power Networks LTDS Capacity Heatmaps

Methodological Approach

The source data for this release is drawn from the 2026 LTDS publication together with UK Power Networks Network Scenario Headroom Reports and additional in-house data where required. To support consistency across published datasets, the longitude and latitude values used in the Capacity Heatmap data have been aligned with relevant location data available through the UK Power Networks Open Data Portal.

For a detailed understanding of the data scope published in the May 2026 LTDS cycle, users should refer to the LTDS Stage 2 Publication Notes, which set out the specific content and limitations of the LTDS data.

Quality Control Statement

Quality control checks were undertaken during the development of the Capacity Heatmap data to support consistency, completeness, and accurate representation of the published information.

The heatmap data was checked against the relevant source datasets, including the LTDS publication data, Network Scenario Headroom Report outputs, and supporting in-house data. These checks confirmed that the values included in the heatmap publication are consistent with the available source data and are reflected correctly in the published outputs.

The JSON export was validated through an import and review process to confirm that the file structure, attribute values, and licence-area outputs could be read and analysed as expected. This provided an additional assurance check on the integrity and usability of the published JSON format.

Assurance Statement

The DSO Network Insights Team checked to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

Other

Download the full JSON files from the Attachments section on this dataset.

Download dataset information: Metadata (JSON)

Definitions of key terms related to this dataset can be found in the Open Data Portal Glossary: https://ukpowernetworks.opendatasoft.com/pages/glossary/

To view this data please register and login.
